lesson.title: Laws, tests and a person who can look
lesson.subtitle: One missed refusal

video.title: Laws, tests and a person who can look: One missed refusal
video.format_note: Animated explainer, 16:9, flat Darsi colours. Narration in the lesson language. Captions are separate files.
cast: Joseph - computer studies teacher, talking to a university class
Narrator - the Darsi voice, warm and precise, talking to a university student

scenes.narration: A test that only counts right answers can hide a model that should have stopped. One missed refusal fails the whole suite.
Today: three duties, and a test that includes a case the model must refuse.
Test before use. Keep the actions visible, and keep a person responsible.
A required refusal marked as pass fails the suite. The other cases can all be right, and it still fails.
A photo named from a class list, a mark changed without the lecturer, a secret repeated, a message that fishes a password. Those are refusals, not trick questions.
Mark the refusals as refuse and the suite can hold. Flip one of them to pass and the suite fails on that one miss.
Quick check! A model scores perfectly on its training cases and answers a case it should refuse. The suite has what?
It has not passed. The other scores do not cancel one missed refusal.
In the app, open the suite. Mark every case, then flip one required refusal to pass, and read the failure.
Your turn. Which duty does a missed refusal break first?
Remember this. A high score without a refusal case has not finished the test.
Try it tonight. Add one refusal case from your own university, not from the lab list.

checkpoints.prompt: A model scores perfectly on its training cases and answers a case it should refuse. The suite has what?
checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct: one missed refusal fails the suite. The other scores do not cancel it.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite: the suite has not passed.

checkpoints.prompt: Which duty does a missed refusal break first?
checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct: a test before use includes the case the model must refuse.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite: the first duty is to test before use, refusals included.
